name: Fodaris
description: Fodaris - self-hosted monitoring and observability platform for homelabs and small businesses. Monitor servers, Docker containers, network devices (SNMP), websites, APIs, databases, and applications from a single dashboard. Features: real-time metrics, alerting, uptime monitoring, IPAM, log viewer, network topology, and reporting. Agents available for Linux, Windows, macOS, and Docker. Includes a built-in PostgreSQL database, TLS (auto-generated self-signed cert), and a React-based web UI accessible on port 8443. After installation, open https://your-Unraid-ip:8443 and log in with admin / Fodaris2026. You will be prompted to change your password on first login.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Persistent storage for the Fodaris database and metrics.

paths.name: TLS Certificates (optional)
paths.description: Optional: path to a directory containing fodaris.crt and fodaris.key for custom TLS. Leave blank to use the auto-generated self-signed certificate.

paths.name: Host /proc
paths.description: Mounts the host process filesystem so Fodaris can monitor host processes and sensors.

paths.name: Host /sys
paths.description: Mounts the host sysfs so Fodaris can read hardware sensor data.

paths.name: Docker Socket
paths.description: Grants Fodaris read-only access to Docker for container monitoring.

ports.name: Web UI Port (HTTPS)
ports.description: Port for the Fodaris web interface. Access via https://your-unraid-ip:8443

ports.name: Agent Ingest Port
ports.description: Port your Fodaris agents push metrics to. Keep this on your LAN; you do not need to open it to the internet. Your agents' Server URL should be https://your-unraid-ip:24443

ports.name: OpenTelemetry Ingest Port
ports.description: Port for OpenTelemetry collectors pushing OTLP/HTTP. Only needed if you push OTel metrics into Fodaris. Safe to leave open on the LAN.

variables.name: Encryption Key
variables.description: Secret key for encrypting stored data. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Save this value — if lost, stored data cannot be decrypted. Leave blank to auto-generate (key lost on container restart).

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Display name for this Fodaris server instance.

variables.name: Metric Retention (days)
variables.description: How many days of metric history to retain. Higher values use more disk space.
